name: top30-motion
description: Copy, style, move, sound, ship: motion-stack picks which of the 18 motion repos a job needs and checks the machine; beat-cues turns a track's beats, bars and sections into frame numbers (librosa); word-captions turns WhisperX word timings into readable SRT, VTT, ASS karaoke or Remotion captions; free-sound finds Openverse music and effects your use allows and writes the credits; ship-video makes platform-ready files (Reels, Shorts, YouTube, GIF, WebM, ProRes) at -14 LUFS and checks them with ffprobe; agent: motion-director.
